text: Yes, the forest on this 58.1-hectare rural property was partially cleared. Earth-observation data confirms **0.7 hectares of tree-cover loss in 2023**, representing about **1.2% of the asset**. The change was detected as stand-replacing loss (e.g., cutting) and corroborated by multiple independent sources, including Hansen GFC and JRC datasets. The affected area was predominantly **planted forest** (0.4 ha *Eucalyptus* spp.), with no native forest involved. The clearing did not meet the threshold for deforestation under standard definitions but constitutes verified tree-cover removal. No information is available on legality or cause (e.g., harvest, fire).
